claims.claim: The left referent billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc. appears as the billed_name on invoices.
The right referent contract:MSA-NBA-2021 lists its counterparty as Northbridge Analytics, Inc.
Commercial notes report that billing and the MSA both use the name Northbridge Analytics Inc.
A 2024 credit check returned a Wyoming LLC named Northbridge Analytics LLC.
Legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party.
The registry link for the contracting party should be treated as unresolved.
billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc. and contract:MSA-NBA-2021 denote the same legal counterparty.
billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc. and contract:MSA-NBA-2021 denote distinct legal counterparties.

support_claim: Although billing and the MSA share a compatible name, the packet explicitly preserves unresolved registry identity and provides no evidence establishing that the billing referent and the contract counterparty are the same or distinct legal entities.
